_comment: R7.2. Villagers standing in the square, placed by scripts/world/village_npcs.gd the same way opening.json places the opening's cast: data describes, code places. `config_key` names a block in data/config/art.json (a tint on Grandpa's or the trainer's rig, never KayKit's Ranger — see art.json's own comment on those keys). `greeting` names a conversation id in data/dialogue/village.json; the prompt label is always "Greet <name>", built by the placer rather than stored here, so it can never accidentally contain "talk" or "choose" — tests/smoke_opening.gd finds Grandpa and the starters by exactly those substrings.
_comment_positions: World metres, on the village square flat (data/config/terrain_playground.json's `flats`, centre [10,-10], radius 18). Chosen and checked against the real runtime structure colliders and the square's four dirt paths (data/config/terrain_playground.json's `paths.routes`, all of which start at [10,-10]) with a headless probe — every position clears every building footprint and every path's 3m width + 1.5m shoulder by several metres, and all three sit far short of Grandpa's house/door/outside markers (~-16,-15 to -9.7,-15), well clear of the smoke test's walked lanes there. `facing_deg` points each villager at the well so the square reads as people gathered around it; `npc_body.gd` turns them to face the player on approach regardless.
